title: Auto-review
description: Choose the provider for Cindy permission reviews. This does not change the model used for the task.
privacy: Jev sends the bounded user authorization, action details and directory permissions directly to TypeSafe. Your API key is encrypted on this device and is never sent to the Cindy gateway.
replaceKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key
keySaved: An encrypted key is saved. Its value cannot be read back here. Saving does not verify API access.
keyRequired: A TypeSafe API key is required before Jev can be enabled.
invalidConfiguration: The saved configuration cannot be read safely. Restore defaults before saving.
loadError: Could not load settings. Reload and try again.
saveError: Could not save the change. The current state has been reloaded where possible. Enter the key again if needed.
changed: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving; unsaved input will be cleared.
restoreHint: Restoring defaults keeps the saved key. Use Delete key to remove it.
coverage: Integration preview: this switch controls the Cindy review channel only. Vendor-native review paths still require integration and verification.
